Initial release of resume-cog, an AI-powered resume and career document builder:

- Builds professional, ATS-optimized resumes, cover letters, LinkedIn profiles, and portfolios tailored to target roles.
- Utilizes CellCog for deep research, industry-specific optimization, and state-of-the-art PDF design.
- Supports prompts for various scenarios: career changes, executive roles, academic CVs, entry-level and more.
- Integrates with the cellcog skill; requires cellcog SDK setup for operation.
- Offers chat-based interface for creating single documents or complete career packages.
